task_completion.description: Log into the Aerobridge system using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Aerobridge dashboard or login screen with 'admin' entered, followed by a successful login to the Django administration panel.

task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Flight plans' model within the 'Flight_Passport' or 'Gcs_Operations' application section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Flight plans' link clicked or the list view of Flight Plan records displayed in the browser.

task_completion.description: Identify and select flight records with a start time strictly before January 1, 2024.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a list of flight plans where records dated 2022 or 2023 are highlighted, filtered, or selected via checkboxes.

task_completion.description: Export or serialize the selected historical records to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a terminal command or a GUI export action referencing the path '/home/ga/archive_pre2024.json' containing the serialized data.

task_completion.description: Delete the identified historical records from the database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a confirmation prompt for deletion or the 'Flight plans' list updated with the pre-2024 records removed.

task_completion.description: Ensure flight plans starting on or after January 1, 2024, remain in the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Flight plans' list showing records with start dates like '2024-01-01' or '2025-05-20' still present after the deletion.

integrity.description: The agent used the Aerobridge web interface for identification and deletion rather than just executing raw SQL commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the browser window with the Aerobridge Django admin interface being navigated.

integrity.description: The agent correctly applied the 'strictly before' logic (records on 2024-01-01 must stay).
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should check that records dated exactly 2024-01-01 were not selected for deletion in the screenshots.

integrity.description: The archive file was created through a process involving the data from the app, not just an empty file creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the content of '/home/ga/archive_pre2024.json' being viewed or generated, containing flight plan data.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The cutoff date is 2024-01-01; records from 2022 and 2023 (e.g., 2022-06-15, 2023-11-20, 2023-12-31) must be archived and deleted. Records from 2024-01-01 00:00:01 onwards must remain. The archive path is /home/ga/archive_pre2024.json. Admin credentials are 'admin' / 'adminpass123'.
